profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: Experienced Ex-Google, Ex-Amazon engineer who loves to build/grow teams to solve big problems.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding member and tech lead of the Advertiser Optimization team which provides features to help advertisers improve campaign performance. Defined tech stack, team goals and practices. Grew team to 15 members and influenced product direction by proposing and implementing new features. 

Similar problem space to my role in DV360 at Google, but using open source technologies (Spark, Python, Typescript for full stack development).

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech lead on the DV360 - Optimus team which builds optimization suggestions (bid, budget, etc) for ads on the DV360 platform. Full-stack development including backend big-data processing, mid-tier web services and client web UI. Lots of data analysis, user behavior analysis and defining/driving business metrics for the team to optimize against.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech lead for the Supply Chain Planning team which built MPS software and process automation for scheduling and delivering Google's computing resources (servers/networking/etc). I worked on building models, simulation, as well designing/building the backend and mid-tier service layers and driving shared architecture across supply chain teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (SDE-III)
positions.description:
Lead for the CMP team that owned a large-scale tier-1 web service that managed 
creation/update of all retail orders on Amazon.com as an orchestrator for hundreds of microservice processing millions of transactions per day with very high availability (99.99%). 

I made multiple major changes to improve latency, decrease service costs and process changes that cut high severity incidents from 2/month to < 1 per quarter as well as cut total ticket load. I also work across teams to help find better methods for reducing operational costs and improving quality/testing processes within eCPS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer for the Mid-Tier Non-Trading group. My primary duties were: designing, implementing and maintaining mid-tier web services, as well as some back end processes for non-trading related functionality. I was also responsible for reviewing code and training/mentoring other team members.

I worked in a primarily Windows based development environment using Visual Studio, C# .NET, WCF and other related Microsoft technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer for the NX/Routing product. Participated in all aspects of software development; gathering requirements, specifying functionality, research, design, implementation and testing.

My duties also include; project planning, training of new developers, coordination of development with other groups, and providing direct support to high-profile customers.

I started working on the NX/Routing product just after its initial release, and helped build it into a mature application with thousands of users.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: Full-time internship (for 9 months, part time for 3 months). Performed maintenance work on the ugto2d and DXF translators.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked part time developing ASP web sites.

educations.schoolName: Missouri University of Science and Technology

patents.title: Metrics-based analysis for testing a service
patents.description: Techniques are described for determining test cases to test a service, such as a service to manage a purchase contract in an e-commerce environment. Log data may be generated during execution of the service to process requests, the log data indicating a plurality of code segments that executed during the execution of the service. The log data may be analyzed to generate metrics data comprising a plurality of records corresponding to the processed requests. A record may include any number of counters that each indicates whether, or how many times, a particular code segment executed during processing of a request. The metrics data may be analyzed to identify a subset of records comprising representative combinations of the counters in the metrics data. The requests corresponding to one or more of the subset of records may be replayed to test the service.

patents.title: System and method for collision-free cad design of pipe and tube paths
patents.description: A system, method, and computer program product for automated creation of collision-free paths for pipes and tubes in a CAD system. A method includes receiving inputs, in a data processing system, defining at least a start point and destination point for a pipe in a CAD environment, and a diameter for the pipe. The method includes determining sample points between the start point and destination point. The method also includes building a graph including the sample points and the start point and the destination points as nodes and a plurality of edges connecting the nodes. The method also includes computing a path through the graph between the start point and the destination point. The method also includes, for each node in the path, testing each edge connected to the node to determine if there is a collision along the edge between a test object model and a background model geometry in the CAD environment, and removing from the graph any edge that has a collision. If there is no collision along an edge of the path, then designating the path as a successful path and displaying the successful path to a user by the data processing system.
